permReq.guideIntro: The browser blocked the permission. Reset it for this site and allow it again:

guide.android:
Tap the lock 🔒 (or ⓘ) next to the site address at the top.
Open "Permissions".
Turn on Camera and Location.
If there's no option, tap "Reset permissions", then reload the page and accept the prompt.
guide.ios:
Tap "aA" on the left of the address bar.
Choose "Website Settings".
Set Camera and Location to "Allow".
If not shown: open Settings → Safari → Camera / Location, set to "Ask" or "Allow", then reload the page.
guide.desktop:
Click the lock 🔒 next to the site URL.
Open "Site settings".
Set Camera and Location to "Allow".
Reload the page (F5).
guide.nativeAndroid:
Open the phone's Settings.
Apps → pick this app.
Permissions → turn on Camera and Location.
Return to the app.
guide.nativeIos:
Open Settings on the iPhone.
Scroll to this app.
Turn on Camera and Location.
Return to the app.

settingsDesc.qrAllowImage: Shows a "read a code from an image" button in the scan screen, so a member can pick a photo of the code instead of pointing the camera at it. Useful when the camera cannot get a clean read (glare, or a code shown on a screen). Turn it off if you want the code to be readable only in person: a screenshot can be forwarded to someone who is not on site. The token’s own validity window still applies either way.
settingsDesc.livenessMode: How the camera proves a live person. Expression asks for a blink, smile, open mouth or raised brows — it stops a printed photo, but a replayed video performs them all. Head turn asks the user to turn their face and measures the depth only a real 3D head produces, so a printed photo AND a phone screen both fail; it takes a second or two longer. Both runs the turn first, then an expression. Applies to the in-app camera (web); the native OS camera has no live feed to run a challenge on.
settingsDesc.faceThreshold: Minimum face-match score (0–1) required to accept a check-in. Higher = stricter.
settingsDesc.livenessRequired: Require a live gesture (blink/turn) so a printed photo or screen can't be used to check in.
settingsDesc.defaultRadius: Default geofence radius, in meters, around a branch when adding a new one.
settingsDesc.maxAccuracy: Reject GPS fixes whose accuracy is worse than this many meters (weak signal / spoofing).
settingsDesc.requireIntegrity: Require the installed native app for check-in — a web browser is rejected. (Full Play Integrity / App Attest anti-root/emulator verification is a native follow-up.)
settingsDesc.qrRequiresMember: Force QR location-bypass codes to target a specific member (not a whole branch).
settingsDesc.qrValidity: How many seconds each location QR code stays valid. The QR page refreshes automatically before it expires, so an old screenshot can't be reused.
settingsDesc.qrBypassMinutes: How many minutes a successful QR scan keeps the member's location bypassed. During this window they can check in/out without GPS.
settingsDesc.enforceShiftWindow: When on, check-in and check-out are only accepted within each shift's own time windows (set per shift on the Shifts page). Outside them they're rejected.
settingsDesc.captureHoldSeconds: How many seconds the member must hold their face steady (after the liveness action) before the photo is captured automatically.
settingsDesc.autoLeaveWork: Automatically mark a member who checked in but never checked out as "left work" once the check-out window closes.
settingsDesc.bypassFace: Skip face recognition at check-in. Only the score/embedding is kept — no face match is enforced.
settingsDesc.bypassLocation: Skip the location / geofence check at check-in. Members can check in from anywhere.
settingsDesc.checkinMethod: App-wide default check-in method for every branch. A branch can only make this stricter, never looser — the more restrictive of global and branch applies.
settingsDesc.bypassCheckoutWindow: App-wide: let members check out at any time (even before the shift's check-out window). Check-in timing stays enforced. A branch, group or member can also enable this on its own.
settingsDesc.showRangeMap: When a check-in is rejected for being outside the branch area, show the member a map with their location, the branch, and the distance between them.
settingsDesc.blockDevOptions: Reject check-in on Android devices that have Developer Options enabled — the setting that lets mock-location apps override GPS. Members are guided to turn it off.
settingsDesc.ipMaxKm: Web only. Rejects a browser check-in when the GPS location is farther than this many km from the device's real internet (IP) location — the one web-visible sign of spoofing. Only catches fakes that are geographically FAR from the real network; near spoofs and mock-location apps can't be caught from a browser (use the native app). Set 0 to disable. Lower = stricter but more false positives on VPN/mobile networks.
settingsDesc.webFrozenGps: Web only. Takes several GPS readings a second apart and rejects the check-in if the position never moves — a real phone GPS always jitters a few metres, a mock app usually feeds a fixed point. Adds a few seconds to each web check-in. May wrongly flag a phone held perfectly still on a smoothed location fix, and is evaded by mock apps that add random movement.
settingsDesc.storeFaceImages: Keep the member's ENROLLMENT face photo in storage (faces/<year>/<code>.jpg). Off = store only the face embedding, never the image.
settingsDesc.storeProbeImages: Keep each check-in/check-out PROBE photo in storage (probes/<year>/<code>/<date>-<type>.jpg). Off = never store the probe image.
